SELECT 'agent' AS metric_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) AS total_count,
COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN created_time < #{todayStart} AND (status_cd = '00A' OR (status_cd = '00X' AND updated_time >= #{todayStart})) THEN 1 END)
0
AS today_increase FROM bt_bot_scene WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scene_type != 'a2a'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'knowledge' AS metric_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) AS total_count,
COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN created_time < #{todayStart} AND (status_cd = '00A' OR (status_cd = '00X' AND updated_time >= #{todayStart})) THEN 1 END)
0
AS today_increase FROM bt_knowledge_base WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model' AS metric_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) AS total_count,
COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN created_time < #{todayStart} AND (status_cd = '00A' OR (status_cd = '00X' AND updated_time >= #{todayStart})) THEN 1 END)
0
AS today_increase FROM bt_library_large_model WHERE 1 = 1
AND data_from IS NULL AND ( tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR (tenant_id = -1 AND is_public = 'T') )
UNION ALL
SELECT 'tool' AS metric_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN status_cd = '00A' THEN 1 END) AS total_count, 0 AS today_increase FROM bt_mcp_server WHERE 1 = 1
AND data_from IS NULL
AND tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1)
SELECT scene_type AS mode_code, COUNT(*) AS mode_count FROM bt_bot_scene WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status_cd = '00A' AND scene_type IN ('scene', 'chatflow', 'knowledge') GROUP BY scene_type

SELECT CASE WHEN source_data.dc_document_type = 'WORD_ONLINE' THEN 'document'
WHEN source_data.dc_document_type = 'EXCEL_ONLINE' THEN 'spreadsheet'
WHEN source_data.file_extension IN ('doc', 'docx', 'pdf', 'ppt', 'pptx', 'txt', 'md', 'html', 'wps') THEN 'document'
WHEN source_data.file_extension IN ('xls', 'xlsx', 'csv', 'tsv') THEN 'spreadsheet'
WHEN source_data.file_extension IN ('jpg', 'jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'bmp', 'svg', 'webp') THEN 'image'
WHEN source_data.file_extension IN ('mp3', 'wav', 'm4a', 'aac', 'flac', 'ogg', 'wma', 'mp4', 'avi', 'mov', 'wmv', 'flv', 'mkv', 'webm', 'mpeg', 'mpg') THEN 'audioVideo'
ELSE 'other' END AS category_code,
COUNT(*) AS file_count
FROM ( SELECT dc.document_type AS dc_document_type, SUBSTRING_INDEX( LOWER(TRIM(f.file_type)), '.', -1 ) AS file_extension
FROM bt_document d
LEFT JOIN bt_file_info fi ON fi.file_info_id = d.file_info_id AND fi.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND fi.status_cd = '00A'
LEFT JOIN bt_file f ON f.file_id = fi.file_id AND f.status_cd = '00A'
LEFT JOIN bt_dc_document dc ON dc.document_id = d.dc_document_id AND dc.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND dc.status_cd = '00A'
WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.status_cd = '00A'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bt_knowledge_base kb WHERE kb.knowledge_id = d.knowledge_id AND kb.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND kb.status_cd = '00A' ) ) source_data
GROUP BY category_code

SELECT s.product_type AS product_type, SUM(s.invoke_count) AS invoke_count FROM bt_dashboard_model_usage_total s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.invoke_count > 0 GROUP BY s.product_type ORDER BY SUM(s.invoke_count) DESC, s.product_type

SELECT message_source.stat_date, SUM(message_source.message_count) AS message_count
FROM (
SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date,
COUNT(*) AS message_count
FROM bt_bot_session_msg m JOIN bt_bot_session s ON s.session_id = m.session_id
WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status_cd = '00A' AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_time >= #{startTime} AND m.created_time < #{endTime}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS message_count FROM bt_bot_session_msg_his m JOIN bt_bot_session_his s ON s.session_id = m.session_id
WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status_cd = '00A' AND m.role = 'user' AND m.created_time >= #{startTime} AND m.created_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) message_source
GROUP BY message_source.stat_date ORDER BY message_source.stat_date
